blocking_reason: The complete checksum-preserved official SBP policy chain is READY: five HTML circulars, two image-only circular PDFs, and the modern SIR PDF establish the 7.00% Phase-2 start state and 20 unique events through 2026-04-28. Canonical macro data remains blocked because daily SBP USD/PKR M2M evidence is absent and PBS CPI is missing one required value month plus exact first-release evidence for 51 required months.

authoritative_sources.exact_definition: State Bank of Pakistan Policy (Target) Rate
authoritative_sources.official_coverage_evidence: Five checksum-preserved official SBP HTML circulars and two checksum-preserved official circular PDFs establish the continuous 2021-2022 target-rate chain and the 7.00% rate effective at the 2021-08-06 Phase-2 start. The checksum-preserved SIR PDF contributes 13 explicit events from 2023-01-24 through 2026-04-28, for 20 unique events in the combined inventory.
authoritative_sources.release_semantics: A new setting is usable no earlier than both its official announcement and documented w.e.f. date. If the announcement predates effectiveness, availability starts at the effective-date boundary. If announcement is same-day or unavailable, the parser conservatively delays availability to the next Lead-Agent decision boundary and does not invent an announcement date.
authoritative_sources.revision_behavior: Rate decisions are event observations; later corrections must be stored as separate vintages and must not rewrite prior availability.
authoritative_sources.vintage_timestamps_available: PARTIAL: MPC announcements are dated; the tabular history exposes w.e.f. dates but not a complete machine-readable announcement timestamp field.
authoritative_sources.machine_readable_history: PARSED_FIRST_PARTY_EVIDENCE: identity-bound parsers handle legacy circular HTML, the two image-only official circular PDFs, and the explicitly labelled SIR target-rate table without conflating Repo/Reverse Repo concepts.
authoritative_sources.access_licensing: Public first-party statistical publication; preserve source attribution and retrieval evidence.

authoritative_sources.exact_definition: National Consumer Price Index year-over-year inflation rate, CPI base 2015-16=100
authoritative_sources.official_coverage_evidence: The preserved PBS historical table contains 108 National CPI YoY reference months from 2017-07 through 2026-06. Preserved official CMS metadata supplies exact timestamps for 11 releases from 2025-10 through 2026-08, nine of which overlap the table.
authoritative_sources.release_semantics: A month-M observation is unavailable until its actual PBS publication. Exact official CMS timestamps govern where preserved. The FAQ's normal first/second-day schedule is not treated as a guaranteed historical not-later-than bound because preserved evidence includes a third-day release and the FAQ does not establish first-release vintages. No synthetic release date is permitted.
authoritative_sources.revision_behavior: First-release values and later revisions must be separate vintages; a revised value may affect only decisions after that revision became available.
authoritative_sources.vintage_timestamps_available: PARTIAL: recent PBS publication posts expose timestamps; older linked reports do not provide a single complete machine-readable first-release timestamp history.
authoritative_sources.machine_readable_history: LIMITED: official historical tables and press releases are primarily PDF; recent post metadata is JSON through the official PBS site.
authoritative_sources.access_licensing: Public first-party statistical publication; preserve source attribution and retrieval evidence.

authoritative_sources.exact_definition: Daily SBP USD Mark-to-Market revaluation exchange rate expressed as Pakistani rupees per U.S. dollar; conversion-rate workbooks are not interchangeable unless SBP evidence proves identical semantics
authoritative_sources.official_coverage_evidence: SBP's official M2M pages and monthly statistical bulletins identify a daily USD Mark-to-Market series. No complete local daily file covering the official-index era has been preserved or schema-verified.
authoritative_sources.release_semantics: Reference-date d is conservatively usable only at the first Phase-2 decision cutoff after the official daily value was published; absent an authoritative intraday timestamp, it cannot enter decision d.
authoritative_sources.revision_behavior: Downloaded annual files are archival snapshots. A changed historical value must be retained as a new source vintage rather than silently replacing the prior observation.
authoritative_sources.vintage_timestamps_available: LIMITED: annual workbook publication and file snapshots are available, but a historical per-row publication timestamp field has not been verified.
authoritative_sources.machine_readable_history: UNVERIFIED: the official M2M history interface and statistical-bulletin tables are authoritative, but no complete downloadable daily schema was acquired. Conversion-rate XLSX files must not be substituted without an identity proof.
authoritative_sources.access_licensing: Public first-party statistical publication; preserve source attribution and retrieval evidence.

raw_evidence_store.overwrite_policy: NEVER_SILENTLY_OVERWRITE; unique retrieval-stamped evidence and manifests

canonical_macro_dataset.reason: A canonical dataset cannot be created until all three authoritative raw evidence histories and release/effective semantics pass validation.

official_market_source.refresh_boundary_policy: derive all returns from ordered official levels

point_in_time_contract.decision_cutoff_rationale: Conservative session-date boundary avoids claiming knowledge of macro releases whose intraday time is unavailable.

feature_contract.ordering: decision_date ascending; one row per common PSX session
feature_contract.feature_warmup: 50 completed official index sessions plus 20 released USD/PKR observations; incomplete rows excluded without future fill
unsafe_inputs_excluded: revised macro values lacking release vintages

common_calendar_split.construction: first floor(70% of N), next floor(15% of N), remainder TEST
common_calendar_split.reason: Exact eligible decision dates are unknowable until canonical macro release coverage exists.

normalization.reason: No exact common TRAIN partition exists while macro evidence is incomplete.

missingness_and_revision_policy.after_safe_release: carry latest known released observation backward-as-of only
missingness_and_revision_policy.revision_policy: retain vintages; revised values take effect only at their own availability timestamp

checks: no TEST rows accepted by TRAIN/VALIDATION selector
deterministic content, calendar, split, and scaler hashes

app_data_management_integration.ownership_decision: P2.2 owns contract/provenance validation only. Macro freshness may be added as a bounded status block in a later Phase-2 data-management follow-up after acquisition is reproducible.

limitations: The SBP policy-rate series is READY from checksum-preserved first-party evidence. Its circular PDFs are image-only and require the fail-closed macOS Vision adapter unless an explicit embedded text layer is present.

PBS CPI values and recent release timestamps are preserved, but historical first-release vintages are incomplete; the current history cannot be projected backward as if it were every original release.
No complete SBP USD/PKR M2M history is preserved or exact daily field schema verified locally; conversion-rate files are not assumed equivalent.
Exact point-in-time macro coverage and therefore exact common split dates are unavailable.

The local official index archive was fetched in 2026 and is not a vintage archive; returns are still causal because they are derived from levels, but historical source revisions cannot be reconstructed.
The conservative start-of-session cutoff may delay same-day official releases until the next decision session.
